senses.gloss:
अक, अस्, आ, अम्, moving tortuously; (अम्), n. pain,
trouble, sin (also derived from अ, not + क, happiness).

अक्का अक्का, f. a mother. [Supposed to be
a term of foreign origin; cf. Lat. Acca.]

अकच अ-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of hair,
bald; (अस्), m., N. of Ketu, the dragon's tail or descend-
ing node, the symbol of which is a headless trunk.

अकण्टक अ-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
thorns, troubles, difficulties, or enemies.
अकत्थन अ-कत्थन, अस्, आ, अम्, not boastful.

आकत्थन आ-कत्थन, अस्, आ, अम्, boasting,
swaggering.

अकथ्य अ-कथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unspeakable;
not to be uttered or mentioned.

अकनिष्ठ अ-कनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not the
youngest; elder, superior; (अस्), m. a deified Buddhist
saint, Buddha.
—अकनिष्ठ-ग, अस्, m. Buddha.
अकन्या अ-कन्या, f. no virgin.
अकपीवत् अकपीवत्, आन्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.

अकम्पित अ-कम्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, unshaken,
firm; (अस्), m., N. of a Jaina saint, a pupil of the last
Tīrtha-kara.

आ-कम्पित or आ-कम्प्र, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken,
trembling; moved, agitated.
अ-कम्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be shaken.
आकर आ-कर, आकरिन्, &c. See under आ-कॄ.

आ-कर, अस्, m. one who scatters over or fills; ac-
cumulation, collection, plenty, multitude; a mine, a
rich source of anything; best, excellent; N. of a
country; N. of the Mahā-bhāṣya.
आकार आ-कार. See under आ-कृ.

आ-कार, अस्, m. form, figure, shape, stature, appear-
ance, aspect, behaviour, external gesture or aspect of
the body, the expression of the face, as furnishing
a clue to the disposition of mind; hint, sign, token;
the letter आ.
—आकार-गुप्ति, इस्, f. or आकार-गोपन,
अम्, n. dissimulation, suppressing all sign or inclina-
tion of the feelings.
—आकार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
a shape, embodied, symmetrical, handsome, well-
formed.
—आकार-वर्ण-सुश्लक्ष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, de-
licate in shape and colour.
अकरण अ-करण, अम्, n. absence of action.

अकारण अ-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, causeless;
(अम्), n. absence of a cause; ind. causelessly.
—अ-का-
रणोत्पन्न (˚ण-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced spon-
taneously.
आकरण आ-करण. See under आ-कृ.

आ-कारण or आ-करण, अम्, आ, n. f. calling, in-
viting, a call or summons; challenging, a challenge.

अ-करणि, इस्, f. non-accomplishment, failure, disap-
pointment (used in imprecations, e. g. तस्याकरणिर्
एवास्तु, may he experience a failure !).
अ-करणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be done.
आ-कारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be called.

अकरुण अ-करुण, अस्, आ, अम्, merciless, re-
lentless.
—अकरुण-त्व, अम्, n. harshness, cruelty.

अकर्कश अ-कर्कश, अस्, आ, अम्, not hard,
not rugged, soft, tender.

अकर्ण अ-कर्ण or अ-कर्णक, अस्, आ, अम्,
without ears, deaf.

आ-कर्ण, up to the ear, (occurs at the commence-
ment of several compounds to denote the end of an
arrow reaching to the ear in drawing a bow.)

अ-कर्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not fit for the ears; not in
the ears.
आ-कर्ण्य, ind. having heard or listened to.

अकर्णधार अ-कर्णधार, अस्, आ, अम्, without
a helmsman, destitute of a pilot.
अकर्तन अ-कर्तन, अस्, m, a dwarf (?).

अकर्तृ अ-कर्तृ, ता, m. not an agent; an
inferior agent.
—अकर्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. condition of an
inferior agent, a subordinate station.

अकर्मन् अ-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, without work,
idle; inefficient; disqualified for performing essential
rites, destitute of good works; (in grammar) intransitive;
(अ), n. absence of work; absence of essential observ-
ances; improper work, crime.
—अकर्म-भोग, अस्, m.
renunciation of self-righteousness; enjoyment of free-
dom from the fruits of action.
—अकर्मान्वित (˚म-
अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, unoccupied, disqualified; criminal.
अ-कर्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, (in grammar) intransitive.

अ-कर्मण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, improper to be done;
unfit for work; inefficient.
अकल अ-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, not in parts, entire.

अकाल अ-काल, अस्, m. a wrong or bad or
inauspicious time; (अस्, आ, अम्), unseasonable.
—अ-
काल-कुष्माण्ड, अस्, m. a pumpkin produced out
of season; a useless birth.
—अकाल-कुसुम, अम्,
n. a flower blossoming out of season.
—अकाल-ज or
अकाल-जात or अ-कालोत्पन्न (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
born or produced at a wrong time, unseasonable.
—अकाल-जलदोदय (˚द-उद्˚) or अकाल-मेघो-
दय (˚घ-उद्˚), अस्, m. unseasonable rise or clouds; a
mist.
—अकाल-वेला, f. unseasonable or unusual time.
—अकाल-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, unable to bide one's time.

आकाल आ-काल, अस्, m. the right time; (for
अ-काल) wrong or inauspicious time.

अकल्क अ-कल्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from sedi-
ment; pure; sinless; (आ), f. moonlight.
—अकल्क-
ता, f. honesty.

अकल्कन अ-कल्कन or अ-कल्कल, अस्, आ, अम्,
free from pride, modest, honest.

अकल्प अ-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, not subject to
rules, uncontrolled; incomparable; unable, weak.

आकल्प आ-कल्प, अस्, m. (rt. कॢप् with आ),
adding to, improving, increasing; ornament, decora-
tion; sickness, disease.

अ-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, not manufactured, not arti-
ficial, not pretended; natural, genuine.

अकल्मष अ-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, sinless,
faultless.

अकल्माष अ-कल्माष, अस्, m., N. of a son
of the fourth Manu.
अकल्य अ-कल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unwell, ill, sick.
अ-काल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unseasonable.

आकल्य आकल्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-कल्य), sick-
ness, disease.

अ-कल्याण, अस्, आ, अम्, not prosperous, inauspicious;
(अम्), n. adversity.

अकव अ-कव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. कु, q. v.),
Ved. not contemptible, not bad.
—अ-कवारि (˚व-
अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. not contemptible as an enemy,
or to his enemies, or in his enemies; not having
weak enemies.

अकवच अ-कवच, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. without
a coat of mail.
अकवि अ-कवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. unwise.

अकस्मात् अ-कस्मात्, ind. without a why or
a wherefore, accidentally, suddenly.

अकाण्ड अ-काण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘without a trunk,’
causeless, unexpected.
—अकाण्ड-पात-जात, अस्, आ,
अम्, dying as soon as born.
—अकाण्ड-शूल, अम्,
n. sudden attack of colic.
अ-काण्डे, ind. causelessly, unexpectedly.

अकातर अ-कातर, अस्, आ, अम्, not down-
hearted, cheerful, hearty.

अकाम अ-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, without desire
or affection, without intention; unintentional, re-
luctant; (in grammar) the Sandhi which causes the
dropping of a final र् before a succeeding र्; (अस्), m.
absence of desire or affection.
—अ-काम-कर्शन,
अस्, m., Ved. not disappointing desires.
—अकाम-तस्,
ind. unintentionally, unwillingly.
—अकाम-ता, f.
freedom from desire or affection or intention.
—अ-
काम-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, not smitten with desire or
affection; free from desire, calm.
अ-कामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, the same as अ-काम.
अकाय अ-काय, अस्, आ, अम्, incorporeal.

आकाय आ-काय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चि with आ), a
funeral pile; abode, residence.

आकाय्य आ-काय्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कि with
आ), Ved. desirable; in every way praiseworthy or
commendable.
अ-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, inactive, not performing.
आकरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, produced in a mine, mineral.

अकार्णवेष्टकिक अ-कार्णवेष्टकिक, अस्, ई, अम्,
not adapted for ear-rings. See कर्ण-वेष्टक.

अकार्य अ-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be done,
impracticable, improper; (अम्), n. a criminal action.
—अकार्य-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, an evil-doer; one who
neglects his duty.

अकार्ष्ण्य अ-कार्ष्ण्य, अम्, n. absence of
blackness.

आकच् आ-कच्, cl. 1. A. -कचते, -चितुम्, to
tie on, to fasten on.

आकन् आ-कन्, cl. 1. P. -कनति, -नितुम्, or
Intens. -चाकन्ति, to be pleased with (with loc.); to
endeavour to obtain; to love, to desire, solicit, praise.

आकम्प् आ-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -पितुम्,
to tremble: Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
tremble.

आ-कम्प, अस्, m. or आ-कम्पन, अम्, n. trem-
bling motion, shaking, trembling.

आकर्ण् आ-कर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -कर्णयति, -यितुम्,
to give ear to, listen to, hear.
आ-कर्णन, अम्, n. hearing, listening.

आ-कर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, heard, listened to; over-
heard.

आकर्ष आ-कर्ष, आ-कर्षिन्, &c. See under
आ-कृष्.

आ-कर्ष, अस्, m. drawing or attracting towards
one's self, pulling to or towards, dragging, attracting,
hawling; drawing the bow; attraction, fascination;
spasm; playing with dice; a die or dice; a board for
such a game; an organ of sense; magnetic attrac-
tion; a magnet, a loadstone; N. of a prince.

आकल् आ-कल्, cl. 10. P. -कलयति, -यितुम्,
to shake, agitate, throw, cast; to lay hold of, seize;
to tie, fasten; to surrender, transfer; to observe, take
into consideration; to consider [cf. Gr. ὀκέλλω].

आ-कलन, अम्, n. binding, confinement; counting,
reckoning; laying hold of; wish, desire.

आ-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound; counted, reckoned;
seized, held.

आ-कल्पक, अस्, m. remembering with regret, miss-
ing; joy; fainting, loss of sense or perception; dark-
ness; a knot or joint.
आ-कल्पम्, ind. till the end of a kalpa.

आकष आ-कष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष्, ‘to rub,’
with आ), a touchstone.

आ-काश, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in Ved. m.) light, clear-
ness; a free space, vacuity; the ether, the sky or
atmosphere considered as the fifth element; Brahma
as identical with ether. आकाश is the subtle and
ethereal fluid, supposed to fill and pervade the uni-
verse and to be the peculiar vehicle of life and of
sound. आकाशे, ind. in the air; a stage direction
implying something said by or to a person out of
sight.
—आकाश-कक्षा, f. the horizon, ‘girdle of the
sky.’
—आकाश-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going through the
atmosphere.
—आकाश-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-
sattva.
—आकाश-चमस, अस्, m. the moon, (‘a cup
[]
or vessel with ether.’)
—आकाश-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, pro-
duced in the sky.
—आकाश-जननिन्, ई, m. a loop-
hole, a casement, an embrasure.
—आकाश-दीप or
आकाश-प्रदीप, अस्, m. a lamp or torch lighted in
honour of Lakṣmī or Viṣṇu and elevated on a pole
in the air at the Dīvāli (Dīpāli) festival, in the month
Kārttika; a beacon, a lantern on a pole.
—आकाश-
प्रतिष्ठित, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—आकाश-
बुद्ध-लक्ष, अस्, m. (in theatrical language) fixing
the gaze on some object out of sight of the audience.
—आकाश-भाषित, अम्, n. (in dramatic language)
speaking outside or off the stage; a supposed speech,
which is replied to as if it had been spoken; a voice
or sound in the air.
—आकाश-मण्डल, अम्, n. the
celestial sphere; the atmosphere.
—आकाश-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, consisting of ether.
—आकाश-मांसी, f. the
plant Nardostachys Jaṭāmāṃsī.
—आकाश-मूली, f. the
aquatic plant Pistia Stratiotes.
—आकाश-यान, अम्, n.
a heavenly car, one moving through the air.
—आकाश-
रक्षिन्, ई, m. a warder, a watchman on the outer
battlements.
—आकाश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, filling a cer-
tain place, spacious, extensive.
—आकाश-वर्त्मन्, अ,
n. the atmosphere, the firmament, the air.
—आकाश-
वल्ली, f. a sort of creeper, a parasite, Cassyta Filiformis.
—आकाश-वाणी, f. a voice from heaven; m., N.
of the author of a Hanumat-stotra.
—आकाश-सलिल,
अम्, n. rain.
—आकाश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, abiding in
the sky, aerial.
—आकाश-स्फटिक, अस्, m. a kind of
crystal supposed to be formed in the atmosphere. It is
of two kinds, Sūrya-kānta and Candra-kānta, q. v.
—आकाशानन्त्यायतन (˚श-अनन्त्य-आय्˚), अम्, n.
abode of infinity or of infinite space; N. of a world
with Buddhists.
—आकाशेश (˚श-ईश्˚), अस्, m. epithet
of Indra, as ruler of the firmament; (in law) any
helpless person, as a child, a woman, a pauper or in-
valid (who has no other possession than the air).

आ-कषक, अस्, इका, अम्, cutting, rubbing, or test-
ing with a touchstone, touching, assaying.
आ-कषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, touching, testing.

आकस्मिक आकस्मिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-कस्मात्),
causeless, unforeseen, unexpected, sudden.
—आकस्मि-
क-त्व, अम्, n. suddenness, &c.

आकाङ्क्ष् आ-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. -काङ्क्षति,
-ते, -षितुम्, to desire, long for, hope for, endeavour
to gain, expect (with acc.); to endeavour to reach a
place, turn to; (in gram.) to require some word or
words to be supplied for the completion of the sense.

आ-काङ्क्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, desiring, wishing; (in
gram.) requiring a word or words to complete the
sense; (आ), f. desire, wish; (in gram.) the requiring
of a word or period for the completion of the sense;
looking at or towards; purpose, intention; enquiry,
asking; the significancy of a word.

आ-काङ्क्षणीय or आ-काङ्क्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be desired or expected, desirable.

आ-काङ्क्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing, expecting;
looking at, looking to or towards.

आ-काङ्क्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired; asked,
enquired; regarded, looked at; wanted, necessary.

आ-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wishing, desirous, wishful,
hopeful; asking, enquiring, expectant.

आ-काङ्क्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, desirable; (अम्), n. need
of supplying a word or words for the completion of
the sense.

आकालिक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, not filling a space of
time, momentary, instantaneous; unseasonable; (ई),
f. lightning.
—आकालिक-त्व, अम्, n. unseasonableness,
suddenness.

आकाश् आ-काश्, cl. 1. A. -काशते, -शितुम्, to
shine, be bright; to view, recognize.

आकाशीय, अस्, आ, अम्, or आकाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, atmo-
spherical.
आकाश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the atmosphere.

आ-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, called, summoned; stipulated,
agreed; demanded, exacted.

आ-कर्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, attractive, what draws
or attracts; (अस्), m. a magnet or loadstone; (इका),
f., N. of a town.
आ-कर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, magnetic, attractive.
आ-कर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn, attracted.

आ-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attractive; (णी), f. a rod with
a hook at the end for pulling down boughs in order
to gather fruit.

अ-कथम्, ind. (fr. 3. अ + 1. कथा), even without
telling, without further words, without any dispute.
